required_condition: component-combination rule is present and identifies component-weight policy as the next blocker
weights may only be symbolic source-side component modifiers before value freeze
any signs must be declared before scoring and cannot be chosen from fit quality
normalization must be dimensionless and cannot be fitted from endpoint performance
weight policy cannot use observed velocities, residuals, heldout scores, best-fit curves, or family winners
a later pre-scoring artifact must freeze actual symbolic or numeric component-weight values before combined anchors can be written
